questions.question: The film based on which of the following novels by Amrita Pritam won the National Film Award?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pinjar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The film **Pinjar** is based on the novel of the same name by **Amrita Pritam**.
 
• **Pinjar** won the National Film Award for Best Feature Film on National Integration.
 
• The novel and the film depict the partition of India and its impact on the lives of the people, especially women.
 
• It is a poignant tale that highlights the struggles and resilience of women during the partition era.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amrita Pritam** was a renowned Indian writer and poet, known for her works in Punjabi and Hindi literature.
 
• She was the first woman to win the **Sahitya Akademi Award** in 1956 for her magnum opus **Sunehade**.
 
• Her works often dealt with themes of love, loss, and the human condition, and she is considered one of the leading literary voices of the 20th century in India.
 
• The film adaptation of **Pinjar** was directed by **Chandra Prakash Dwivedi** and released in 2003.

questions.question: Which of the following persons won the ‘Best Female Debut’ Award at the 2021 Paralympic Sports Awards 2021?

• Indian shooter Avani Lekhara__ has won a gold medal in women’s 10 metre air rifle shooting at Tokyo Paralympics.

questions.question: Bharatanatyam dancer ________ received the Natya Kala Sarathy award from Sri Parthasarathy Swami Sabha in 2023 at Chennai.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Srekala Bharath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Srekala Bharath, a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer, was honored with the **Natya Kala Sarathy award** in 2023.
 
• The award was presented by the **Sri Parthasarathy Swami Sabha**, one of the oldest and most prestigious cultural organizations in Chennai.
 
• Srekala Bharath is known for her contributions to the preservation and promotion of the **Bharatanatyam dance form**.
 
• The Natya Kala Sarathy award recognizes individuals for their exemplary achievements in the field of classical dance.
 
• The award ceremony was held in Chennai, a hub for classical arts and culture in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• An Indian classical dance form originating from Tamil Nadu, Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest dance traditions in the world.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, graceful movements, and expressions (abhinaya) that narrate stories from Hindu mythology.
 
• Bharatanatyam is often performed in temples as a form of devotion and is deeply rooted in spiritual themes.
 
 
 
• **Sri Parthasarathy Swami Sabha**
 
 
• Founded in 1900, it is one of the oldest cultural institutions in India.
 
• The Sabha is committed to promoting and preserving Indian classical music, dance, and drama.
 
• It organizes annual events and festivals to honor artists and provide a platform for cultural expression.
 
 
 
• **Natya Kala Sarathy Award**
 
 
• This award is presented by Sri Parthasarathy Swami Sabha to recognize outstanding contributions to classical dance.
 
• It celebrates the dedication and artistry of individuals who have enriched the performing arts.
 
• Winners are selected based on their body of work, influence on the art form, and commitment to cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Chennai: A Cultural Hub**
 
 
• Chennai, also known as the cultural capital of South India, is renowned for its patronage of classical arts.
 
• The city hosts prestigious events like the Margazhi Festival, drawing performers and audiences from around the globe.
 
• It is home to numerous art institutions and sabhas that play a pivotal role in preserving India's rich cultural legacy.

questions.question: How many Grammy Awards has AR Rahman won?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Grammy awards are presented for outstanding achievement in the music field and are presented by the Recording Academy in the United States which were earlier called the Gramophone awards.
 
 
• **The Grammy awards were first presented in 1958-59 and have been held annually.**
 
 
 
• AR Rahman is an Indian music composer who works in many languages like Tamil, Hindi, Telugu etc and also in Hollywood with 20th Century fox studios.
 
• He began his musical journey in movies with the Tamil film Roja in 1992 directed by Mani Ratnam and won the Nation award for Best Musical Direction.
 
• **For Slumdog Millionaire in 2009, he won 2 Grammy Awards in the categories of Best Compilation Soundtrack Album for a Motion Picture and Best Song was written for a Motion Picture (for the song Hai Ho). Hence option 3 is correct.**
 
• He won the Golden Globe Award for Slumdog Millionaire and was nominated for the same for 127 Hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The latest Grammy (2023) was given to "Don't Shut Me Down" by ABBA, a Swedish group.**
 
• **In 2009, he won two Oscars or the Academy Awards for the movie Slumdog Millionaire in the Best Original Score and Best Original Song categories.**
 
• He was honoured with Padma Sri in 2000 and with Padma Bhushan in 2010 by the Government of India.
 
• The Academy Awards are prestigious awards given in many categories related to the film industry.

questions.question: Which of the following awards is NOT conferred for excellence in dance?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lalit Kala Akademi Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Lalit Kala Akademi Award** is conferred for excellence in the field of visual arts, including painting, sculpture, and other forms of fine arts, not dance.
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**, established in 1952, is given for exceptional work in the fields of music, dance, and drama.
 
• The **Kalidas Samman Award**, instituted by the Government of Madhya Pradesh, honors outstanding achievements in classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts.
 
• The **Padma Shree Award** is one of India’s highest civilian honors and is given for distinguished service in various fields, including arts, which encompasses dance.
 
• The **Lalit Kala Akademi Award** specifically focuses on visual arts and has no connection to dance, making it the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lalit Kala Akademi**

 
 
• Established in 1954, the Lalit Kala Akademi (National Academy of Art) promotes and propagates understanding of Indian art both within and outside the country.
 
• The Akademi organizes national and international exhibitions and awards scholarships and fellowships to support artists.
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi**
 
 
• India’s national academy for music, dance, and drama, it was set up in 1953.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards are considered the highest national recognition for performing artists, including dancers.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas Samman**
 
 
• Instituted in 1980, the Kalidas Samman is awarded annually by the Madhya Pradesh government.
 
• It is given in fields such as classical dance, classical music, theatre, and visual arts.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**
 
 
• The Padma Awards, namely Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shree, are among the highest civilian honors of India.
 
• They are awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in various domains, including arts, education, sports, and more.

questions.question: Who among the following is the first Indian to get an Oscar Award?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhanu Athaiya**__.

__
 
• **Bhanu Athaiya became the first Indian to win an Academy Award in 1983 for designing the costumes for Richard Attenborough's Gandhi**__.

 __
 
• She jointly won the Academy Award for Best Costume Design with John Mollo for Richard Attenborough's "Gandhi".
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• At the 30th Academy Awards, Mehboob Khan's 1957 Hindi-language film Mother India was India's first submission for the Academy Award for the Best International Feature Film category.

 
 
• It was nominated along with four other films and lost by one vote to the Italian film Knights of Cabiria (1957).
 
• In 1982, the National Film Development Corporation of India was instrumental in co-producing the Richard Attenborough biographical film Gandhi.
 
• Bhanu Athaiya became the first Indian to win an Academy Award for costume design at the 55th Academy Awards.
 
• Ravi Shankar was nominated for Best Original Score for the same film. As of 2021, apart from Mother India, only two Indian films have been nominated for an Oscar – Salaam Bombay! (1988) and Lagaan (2001).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Academy Awards, popularly known as the Oscars, are awards given for artistic and technical merit in the film industry.

 
 
• First awarded May 16, 1929

questions.question: Bharatanatyam Guru _______ received the Nrithya Seva Ratna award from Indian Fine Arts Akademi, San Diego in 2023.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hema Rajagopalan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Hema Rajagopalan is a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer and choreographer.
 
• She received the Nrithya Seva Ratna award from the Indian Fine Arts Akademi, San Diego, in 2023.
 
• Hema Rajagopalan is the founder and artistic director of the Natya Dance Theatre in Chicago.
 
• She has been instrumental in promoting Bharatanatyam in the United States for several decades.
 
• Her contributions to Indian classical dance have been recognized both in India and abroad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form is deeply rooted in Hindu religious themes and mythology.
 
• Bharatanatyam was traditionally performed by Devadasis in temples and courts of southern India.
 
• It has evolved into a widely performed dance form both in India and internationally.
 
 
 
• **Indian Fine Arts Akademi, San Diego**
 
 
• The Indian Fine Arts Akademi, San Diego, is an organization dedicated to promoting Indian classical arts in the United States.
 
• It organizes various cultural events, workshops, and performances to celebrate Indian classical music, dance, and other art forms.
 
• The Akademi aims to provide a platform for artists to showcase their talent and preserve the rich cultural heritage of India.
 
 
 
• **Natya Dance Theatre**
 
 
• Natya Dance Theatre is a premier Bharatanatyam dance company based in Chicago, founded by Hema Rajagopalan.
 
• The theatre is dedicated to promoting and preserving the classical dance form of Bharatanatyam.
 
• It offers classes, workshops, and performances to educate and engage audiences in Indian classical dance.
 
• Natya Dance Theatre has received numerous accolades for its artistic excellence and contributions to the cultural landscape.
 
 
 
• **Nrithya Seva Ratna Award**
 
 
• The Nrithya Seva Ratna award is a prestigious recognition given to individuals for their outstanding contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• It is awarded by various cultural organizations to honor the dedication and achievements of dancers and choreographers.
 
• Recipients of the award are celebrated for their efforts in preserving and promoting the art form.
 
• The award highlights the significance of dance as a cultural and artistic expression.

questions.question: Filmmaker Utpal Borpujari's documentary, 'Songs of the ________' is based on the folk songs and culture of the Naga tribes.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Blue Hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Filmmaker Utpal Borpujari’s documentary, Songs of the Blue Hills, seeks out lost Naga folk songs and finds their revival among younger musicians. Hence, Option 4 is correct.**
 
• The film seeks out folk songs of the Nagas that are lost or have trickled down to the next generation.
 
• **The arrival of the British over a century ago was culturally helpful in some parts of the nation (they facilitated many musicians such as Gauhar Jaan to find fame by allowing them to record), while they banned folk music of the Naga tribes calling it spirit worship.**
 
• Ao tribe had their script written on leather strips.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Naga Tribe**

 
 
• **Nagas belong to Indo-Mongoloid Family.**
 
• The Nagas are not a single tribe, but an ethnic community that comprises several tribes who live in the state of Nagaland and its neighbourhood. As of 2012, the state of Nagaland state officially recognises 17 Naga tribes. Prominent Naga tribes: Poumai, Sumi, Angami, Ao, Chakhesang, Chang, Khiamniungan, Konyak, Liangmai, Lotha, Pochury, Rongmei, Zeme, Mao.
 
• **Greater Nagalim**: A region carved out by integrating all Naga-inhabited contiguous areas under one administrative umbrella.
 
• It includes several districts of Assam, Arunachal and Manipur, as also a large tract of Myanmar.
 
• The map of “Greater Nagalim” has about 1,20,000sq km, while the state of Nagaland consists of 16,527 sq km.
